articles.summary: Chinese domestic chip manufacturers are collectively expanding into Germany, signaling a push to access European markets and partnerships amid ongoing US-China trade restrictions. This move reflects the geopolitical pressure reshaping global semiconductor supply chains.

articles.title: United Airlines blocks AI agents from booking flights, citing cybersecurity risks
articles.summary: United Airlines announced it will not permit AI agents to book flights or manage reservations on behalf of customers, citing cybersecurity concerns. The move signals early resistance from incumbent industries to autonomous AI agents operating within their transaction systems.

articles.title: Trump floats Apple chairman Tim Cook as Jensen Huang’s successor
articles.summary: President Trump publicly suggested Apple chairman Tim Cook as a potential successor to Jensen Huang at Nvidia via a Truth Social post. The suggestion underscores the political dimension of Nvidia's leadership crisis and its perceived importance to U.S. national interests.

articles.title: ‘Bring Back THE Boss’: Nvidia Employees Petition for Jensen Huang’s Return
articles.summary: An internal Nvidia petition calling for Jensen Huang's reinstatement has garnered over 1,600 comments, the majority supporting his return. The employee groundswell illustrates the deep cultural imprint Huang left on Nvidia and the uncertainty his departure has created internally.

articles.title: Silicon Valley Is Still Defending Jensen Huang
articles.summary: Silicon Valley insiders and Nvidia employees have largely rallied behind Jensen Huang following his resignation, with many expressing disbelief that he was forced out. The reaction reflects how central Huang was to the tech industry's identity and the difficulty of accepting a paradigm shift at Nvidia's helm.

articles.title: Google DeepMind Staff Tap the UK Government to Escalate Their Unionization Fight
articles.summary: Workers at Google DeepMind are escalating their unionization effort by appealing directly to the UK government after internal talks with management stalled. The move could set a precedent for labor organizing within elite AI research institutions and prompt regulatory attention to worker rights in the sector.

articles.title: United Airlines Blocks A.I. Agents From Booking Flights
articles.summary: United Airlines has banned AI agents from logging into customer accounts and managing flight bookings, citing data protection and regulatory compliance concerns. The move highlights a growing tension between the rapid deployment of agentic AI systems and existing privacy and consumer protection frameworks.

articles.title: Sequoia Capital to Invest in AI Holding Co. Sequence - The Information
articles.summary: Sequoia Capital is set to invest in Sequence, an AI holding company, signaling continued venture confidence in diversified AI investment structures. The deal reflects major venture firms doubling down on portfolio-level AI bets rather than single-company investments.

articles.title: The Blue Wave May Not Stop Musk’s Texas Data Center Ambitions - The Information
articles.summary: Despite potential political shifts from a 'blue wave' in Texas, Elon Musk's data center expansion plans in the state are unlikely to be significantly impeded, given existing regulatory and business-friendly frameworks. This suggests AI infrastructure buildout may remain insulated from near-term political changes at the state level.

articles.title: 英伟达创始人黄仁勋卸任总裁与CEO
articles.summary: Nvidia founder Jensen Huang has resigned as President, CEO, and board member following a scandal involving extramarital affairs, including one allegedly with a Chinese spy. The departure of Nvidia's only-ever CEO—who is synonymous with the company's AI chip dominance—creates major uncertainty for the company's strategic direction and AI industry leadership.

articles.title: How Amplitude ships product improvements in 1–2 days with OpenAI
articles.summary: Analytics platform Amplitude built an AI product agent called Wave using OpenAI models, enabling it to identify product improvements and ship changes within one to two days. The case study illustrates how enterprise software companies are integrating AI coding agents to dramatically accelerate development cycles.

articles.title: More game developers are starting to use generative AI
articles.summary: According to GDC's annual industry survey, 40% of game developers now use generative AI as part of their jobs, up from 36% the previous year, with higher adoption among larger studios. The steady increase signals that generative AI is becoming a normalized tool in creative and technical game development workflows.

articles.title: Cyberattack on Fireworks AI allowed hackers to access Notion customers’ chat transcripts
articles.summary: A cyberattack on AI inference platform Fireworks AI enabled hackers to access Notion customers' chat transcripts, marking Fireworks' second data breach in two months. The incident raises serious concerns about supply-chain security in AI infrastructure and the exposure of sensitive enterprise data.

articles.title: Gondola doubles revenue as its team builds more with Codex
articles.summary: Creative portfolio platform Gondola doubled its revenue after integrating OpenAI's Codex, which boosted its lead engineer's output by 50%. The result demonstrates the growing productivity and business impact of AI coding tools for small tech teams.

articles.title: Muse can now place calls to US businesses — if you pay
articles.summary: AI assistant Muse has launched a paid feature allowing its AI to place outbound phone calls to US businesses on behalf of users. The move marks a step toward commercially deployed voice AI agents capable of autonomous real-world interactions.

articles.title: Nectar launches an AI agent to automate creator discovery and outreach for brands
articles.summary: Startup Nectar has launched an AI agent that automates influencer marketing tasks including creator discovery, outreach, partnership management, and campaign tracking for brands. The tool reflects the growing application of autonomous AI agents to streamline marketing workflows.

articles.title: Synchron Pauses Trials of Its Brain Implant Due to Performance Issues
articles.summary: Brain-computer interface startup Synchron has paused its clinical trials after its latest implant device underperformed, with plans to upgrade hardware and develop a new device. The halt is a setback for the BCI field and highlights the significant engineering challenges remaining before such technologies can reach broad clinical use.

articles.title: We Were Warned of Deceptive A.I. Fakes. We Got Memes.
articles.summary: A post-election analysis finds that the feared wave of sophisticated AI-generated deepfakes did not materialize during the election season; instead, AI fakes appeared mainly as memes. The finding challenges prevailing assumptions about AI disinformation threats and raises new questions about where the real risks lie.

articles.title: Qualcomm begins India job cuts as handset chip sales slide
articles.summary: Qualcomm has begun job cuts in India as sales of handset chips decline, reflecting softening demand in the mobile semiconductor market. The reductions highlight ongoing pressure on chip companies dependent on consumer device cycles amid a shifting focus toward AI-specific silicon.

articles.title: Samsung reportedly moves up 8-inch foundry exit to 2029, outsources some production to UMC
articles.summary: Samsung has reportedly accelerated its exit from 8-inch foundry production to 2029 and is outsourcing some manufacturing to UMC, signaling a strategic restructuring of its semiconductor operations. This shift could affect supply availability for certain legacy chips and reshape competitive dynamics in the foundry market.

articles.title: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia chief executive
articles.summary: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO and shares tumbled 13%, with CFO Colette Kress appointed interim head of the AI chipmaking giant. The abrupt leadership change at the company powering much of the global AI infrastructure sent shockwaves through financial markets.

articles.title: 百度文心大模型再升级：ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview 亮相，模型权重将于 11 月 25 日前正式开源
articles.summary: Baidu released ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview, the first post-trained version of its base model, featuring 280B parameters, 1M context support, and a commitment to full open-source release by November 25. The planned open-sourcing of a large-scale Chinese frontier model adds competitive pressure to the global open-source AI ecosystem.

articles.title: 阿里重磅官宣千问大模型 Qwen4：核心能力全线进化，千问 App 现已全面接入预览版
articles.summary: Alibaba announced Qwen4, the next generation of its Qwen large language model series, featuring a fully redesigned architecture with significant performance improvements across knowledge understanding and complex context handling, with a preview already integrated into the Qwen App. This positions Alibaba aggressively in the ongoing Chinese frontier model race alongside Baidu and Tencent's concurrent releases.

articles.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns amid spy, affair scandals
articles.summary: Nvidia co-founder and CEO Jensen Huang resigned after the company's board investigated reports of two extramarital affairs, one involving an alleged Chinese spy and another with a direct subordinate. The departure of the central figure of the AI chip boom introduces major uncertainty for Nvidia and the broader AI infrastructure industry.

articles.title: Jensen Huang is gone. Will the AI industry pay the price?
articles.summary: Analysts warn that Jensen Huang's departure from Nvidia could destabilize the financial and technological ecosystem that has underpinned the AI boom, given Nvidia's central role in supplying AI compute. The loss of Huang's leadership may slow deal-making, partnerships, and innovation cycles across the industry.

articles.title: 追赶国际AI第一梯队还需数年?张一鸣谈字节大模型研发目标
articles.summary: ByteDance CEO Zhang Yiming reportedly told internal AI teams that the company can compete with OpenAI and Anthropic but may need until 2029–2030 to fully close the gap, citing pretraining data scale as a key deficit. This candid internal assessment highlights the sustained competitive distance between Chinese and leading Western frontier AI labs and signals ByteDance's long-term investment commitment.

articles.title: 火山引擎推出Seedance2.5flash:生成速度翻倍，720P约0.99元/秒、较旗舰降低34%
articles.summary: Volcano Engine (ByteDance) launched Seedance 2.5 Flash, a cost-optimized video generation model offering double the speed of its flagship at ~0.99 RMB/second for 720P, a 34% price reduction. The move intensifies competition in AI video generation by targeting bulk content production use cases with aggressive pricing.

articles.title: 百度发布大模型交易平台“词元所”：宣称中立可信，打造大模型界的“证券交易所”
articles.summary: At Baidu World 2026, Robin Li launched 'Ciyuansuo,' a large model token trading platform modeled after a stock exchange, designed to solve trust and verification challenges enterprises face when selecting AI models. The platform introduces neutral third-party model vetting and credit rating mechanisms, potentially reshaping how enterprises discover and procure AI model services in China.

articles.title: 李彦宏:AI变革不只是技术革命，企业需要围绕智能体重构组织
articles.summary: At Baidu World 2026, Robin Li argued that AI represents not just a technological revolution but an organizational one, predicting that 'intelligent organizations' built around agents will become the defining competitive unit of the AI era. This framing—comparing AI infrastructure to industrial-era factories—reflects growing executive consensus that enterprise restructuring around AI agents is now a strategic imperative.

articles.title: 通芯智能完成数亿元种子轮及天使轮融资，龙芯海光背景团队研发AGI架构芯片 - 电子工程专辑EE Times China
articles.source_name: 电子工程专辑 (EE Times China)
articles.summary: Tongxin Intelligence, a Chinese chip startup founded by veterans from Loongson and Hygon, has raised hundreds of millions of RMB in seed and angel funding to develop AGI-architecture chips. The funding highlights continued investor appetite for domestic Chinese AI chip development amid ongoing US export restrictions.

articles.title: 实测百度文心5.5 Flash Preview：审美依然在线，编程全力争先
articles.summary: Hands-on testing of Baidu's ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview shows strong performance in programming, 3D modeling, knowledge work, and content creation. The evaluation positions the model as a competitive entry in the Chinese frontier model landscape, particularly for developer-facing coding tasks.

articles.title: BAT新旗舰杀回第一阵营，压力来到字节这边
articles.summary: Baidu, Alibaba, and Tencent all released major model upgrades in the same week, reclaiming competitive standing in the Chinese AI frontier—while ByteDance's Seed 2.1 has gone nearly six months without an update. The simultaneous BAT resurgence intensifies pressure on ByteDance to accelerate its model development cadence.

articles.title: Meet Colette Kress, Nvidia’s New Interim CEO
articles.summary: Nvidia's longtime CFO Colette Kress has been named interim CEO following Jensen Huang's resignation, bringing deep financial and operational knowledge of the company. Her appointment provides short-term stability but leaves open questions about Nvidia's strategic direction in the intensely competitive AI chip market.

articles.title: Jensen Huang Ousted as Nvidia CEO
articles.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang was ousted by the board following reports of multiple affairs, one involving a woman suspected of spying for China, with CFO Colette Kress named interim CEO. The departure of Huang, the architect of Nvidia's AI chip dominance, creates significant uncertainty for the company and the broader AI industry that depends on its hardware.

articles.title: Nvidia Drama Triggers Difficult Search for Huang’s Successor
articles.summary: Nvidia has begun a difficult search for a successor to Jensen Huang, whose outsized personal role in shaping the company's AI strategy makes replacement uniquely challenging. Finding a leader capable of maintaining Nvidia's technological edge and industry relationships is seen as critical to its continued dominance.

articles.title: Trump Asked to Preserve Nvidia Documents by Senators
articles.summary: Senators Elizabeth Warren and Chris Coons asked the Trump administration to preserve all records related to Nvidia chip exports to China, amid concerns about diversion of advanced semiconductors. The request reflects intensifying congressional scrutiny over AI hardware export controls in the wake of the Huang scandal.

articles.title: China warns US not to use Nvidia scandal as pretext for tech curbs
articles.summary: China's government accused the US of fabricating espionage narratives that ultimately forced Jensen Huang's resignation from Nvidia. Beijing's response signals that it views the scandal as a geopolitically motivated effort to justify further restrictions on advanced chip technology.

articles.title: Anthropic Launches New Workplace Software, Sending Microsoft Shares Tanking - The Information
articles.summary: Anthropic launched new workplace productivity software, directly competing with Microsoft's enterprise AI offerings and causing Microsoft shares to drop. The move signals Anthropic's ambition to expand beyond AI model development into the lucrative enterprise software market.

articles.title: Commerce Department Finalizing Long-Awaited AI Remote Access Rule - The Information
articles.summary: The US Commerce Department is finalizing a long-anticipated rule governing remote access to AI systems, which could have sweeping implications for how foreign entities interact with American AI infrastructure. The rule is part of broader efforts to prevent adversaries from leveraging US AI capabilities without direct chip exports.

articles.title: 单张消费级显卡跑出60FPS游戏世界:Matrix-Game4.0上线Reactor，浏览器里「边玩边生成
articles.summary: Kunlun Tech's Matrix-Game 4.0, a video game world model, has launched on the Reactor platform, enabling real-time interactive world generation at 60FPS/480p on a single consumer GPU (RTX 5090) via a browser. This marks a significant milestone in AI-generated interactive media, lowering the hardware barrier for real-time neural world simulation and opening it to global developers via SDK/API.

articles.title: 国产地震大模型“谛听”亮相：汇聚 2000 万数据集，让 AI 听懂地球“心跳”
articles.summary: China's domestically developed seismic AI model 'Diting' has been unveiled, trained on over 20 million high-quality seismic data records and capable of rapid earthquake reporting from single-station data. The model demonstrates AI's expanding role in scientific and disaster-prevention applications, particularly for earthquake monitoring and early warning.

articles.title: Chinese Workers Are Paying Their Own AI Bills to Stay Productive
articles.summary: Chinese workers are increasingly paying out of pocket for generative AI subscriptions and API costs to remain productive, as employers rarely reimburse these expenses, creating an unofficial personal AI tax on labor. This trend reveals a structural gap between AI adoption rates and corporate AI investment policies, with implications for labor costs and AI productivity diffusion in China.

articles.title: Alibaba’s Chip Unit Heads for Hong Kong With Cloud Still in the Way
articles.summary: Alibaba is planning to list its chip subsidiary T-Head on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange after eight years as an internal unit, though financial transparency remains limited due to most revenue flowing through Alibaba Cloud. The planned IPO reflects strategic moves by Chinese tech giants to independently surface AI hardware assets, though mixed financials may challenge investor confidence.

articles.title: 机器人泡沫在老股市场漏了气
articles.summary: Despite continued hot primary-market funding in embodied AI—with Xingchen Intelligence raising 1 billion RMB at a 15 billion RMB valuation—secondary market sellers of older shares are accepting 20–35% discounts, signaling investor caution around mass production timelines and order sustainability. This divergence between primary enthusiasm and secondary-market skepticism reflects maturing risk assessment in China's robotics investment cycle.

articles.title: 聊聊中国版MUSE：蚂蚁灵光2.0，支付宝，超级App的生态优势与挑战
articles.summary: Ant Group's Lingyuan 2.0, integrated within Alipay's super-app ecosystem, is positioned as China's answer to multimodal AI models like MUSE. The development highlights how Chinese tech giants are leveraging existing platform ecosystems to accelerate AI deployment and compete with Western foundation models.

articles.title: Who could replace Jensen Huang? A highly unscientific list of possible successors
articles.summary: Following Jensen Huang's resignation, analysts and observers are speculating about potential successors to lead Nvidia, noting the company lacks a formal succession plan. Leadership continuity is a critical concern given Nvidia's dominant role in supplying AI hardware globally.

articles.title: TSMC sees surging AI chip demand, highlights advanced packaging and physical AI opportunities
articles.summary: TSMC reported surging demand for AI chips and highlighted opportunities in advanced packaging and physical AI as key growth areas. This signals that AI hardware demand continues to outpace supply capacity, reinforcing TSMC's strategic position in the AI supply chain.

articles.title: The China chip self-sufficiency paradox: YMTC eyes 2027 IPO as restricted Nvidia GPUs reach Chinese universities
articles.summary: Chinese memory chipmaker YMTC is targeting a 2027 IPO as it pursues self-sufficiency, even as restricted Nvidia GPUs continue to reach Chinese universities through unclear channels. The situation illustrates the paradox of US export controls: stimulating Chinese domestic chip development while failing to fully cut off access to advanced foreign hardware.

articles.title: AI bottleneck shifts from compute to power; European supply chain sees power semiconductors as next shortage
articles.summary: Industry analysts report that the primary bottleneck for AI development is shifting from compute availability to power supply, with European semiconductor companies positioning power chips as the next critical shortage. This transition could reshape AI infrastructure investment priorities and create new supply chain vulnerabilities.

articles.title: Suspected Chinese spy at center of Jensen Huang affair surfaces in Beijing
articles.summary: Alice Huang, the woman at the center of the Jensen Huang affair and suspected spy scandal, has surfaced in Beijing amid widespread speculation about her background and relationship with the former Nvidia CEO. Her presence in China fuels ongoing geopolitical questions about potential technology transfer risks linked to the scandal.

articles.title: Google reworks TPU silicon into specialized systems for agents and security
articles.summary: Google has repurposed its TPU 8i and TPU 8t silicon into two specialized systems—TPU 8i Max and TPU 8tx—targeting long-context AI agents and confidential inference workloads respectively. The move demonstrates Google's strategy of extending existing chip designs into niche high-value AI use cases rather than relying solely on new silicon generations.

articles.title: 腾讯辟谣裁员50%:计划将一半力量投入AI Native探索
articles.summary: Tencent's PR director publicly denied rumors of 50% layoffs, clarifying that the company's organizational changes are AI-driven transformation toward efficiency and innovation rather than cost-cutting. The denial underscores how major Chinese tech firms are reframing workforce restructuring as AI-native organizational evolution rather than retrenchment.

articles.title: 重构AI存储逻辑，长鑫携全场景内存矩阵亮相 - 电子工程专辑EE Times China
articles.source_name: 电子工程专辑 (EE Times China)
articles.summary: CXMT (Changxin Memory Technologies) showcased a full-scenario memory matrix aimed at restructuring AI storage logic for diverse AI workloads. As AI model memory demands grow, domestic Chinese memory solutions from CXMT represent a strategic effort to reduce reliance on foreign HBM and DRAM suppliers.

articles.title: 库库，服务全球的中国AI样本 - 电子工程专辑EE Times China
articles.source_name: 电子工程专辑 (EE Times China)
articles.summary: An EE Times China feature profiles a Chinese AI company serving global markets as a representative case study of China's AI export ambitions. This highlights the growing international footprint of Chinese AI products and the geopolitical implications of Chinese AI platforms scaling globally.

articles.title: 两城双子星，正在完成中国AI产业闭环。
articles.summary: An analysis examines how two Chinese cities are building complementary AI industrial ecosystems that together may complete China's domestic AI supply chain loop. This geographic clustering of AI talent, chips, models, and applications represents a structural approach to reducing China's dependence on foreign AI infrastructure.

articles.title: 35秒内阻断失控的智能体，OpenAI部署“控制室”系统
articles.summary: OpenAI has deployed a 'control room' system capable of blocking runaway AI agents within 35 seconds. This represents a concrete operational step toward AI containment and safety infrastructure, signaling growing industry focus on agentic AI risk mitigation.

articles.title: 大模型越狱攻击的内部模式
articles.summary: A new analysis examines the internal mechanics of jailbreak attacks on large language models, identifying structural patterns in how adversarial prompts bypass safety guardrails. Understanding these patterns is critical for improving model alignment and robustness against misuse.

articles.title: Supporting research on AI and children’s safety
articles.summary: OpenAI is committing $2 million to fund research into AI risks and opportunities specifically affecting children, including developing shared measurement tools. The investment signals growing industry attention to vulnerable user populations and may preempt regulatory pressure around child safety.

articles.title: The Nvidia Board Members Who Decided Jensen Huang’s Fate
articles.summary: A profile of the Nvidia board members who voted to oust Jensen Huang reveals a diverse group with backgrounds spanning fast food franchising to academic research. The composition of the board that made one of the most consequential decisions in AI industry history is drawing scrutiny.

articles.title: Singapore Bars Alice Huang From Entry After False-Document Probe
articles.summary: Singapore barred Alice Huang from entry after finding insufficient evidence to prosecute her following a false-document probe linked to the spy scandal that contributed to Jensen Huang's ouster. The case highlights the intersection of corporate espionage concerns and geopolitical tensions over AI chip access.

articles.title: Sex, spies and salaries shake up AI chipmakers
articles.summary: An in-depth account from Nikkei Asia and the Financial Times explores how sex scandals, espionage allegations, and executive pay disputes are reshaping the AI chip industry in Asia. The piece contextualizes the Nvidia CEO crisis within broader tensions in the Asian tech ecosystem.

articles.title: Can anything derail Anthropic’s IPO?
articles.summary: Anthropic is pressing forward with its IPO plans despite turbulence in the broader AI investment landscape. The move reflects confidence in Anthropic's market position but raises questions about valuation sustainability amid shifting sentiment toward AI stocks.

articles.title: 从辅助工具到实时协作者，AI超声设备开启端侧智能新范式 - 电子工程专辑EE Times China
articles.source_name: 电子工程专辑 (EE Times China)
articles.summary: AI-powered ultrasound devices are evolving from passive assistive tools to real-time collaborative systems through edge-side intelligence. This development signals a new paradigm for on-device AI in medical imaging, reducing dependence on cloud connectivity and enabling smarter point-of-care diagnostics.

articles.title: AI时代下的整车开发流程 - 电子工程专辑EE Times China
articles.source_name: 电子工程专辑 (EE Times China)
articles.summary: An EE Times China analysis examines how AI is transforming vehicle development workflows in the automotive industry. AI integration into the full vehicle development cycle represents a major application shift with implications for manufacturing efficiency and autonomous driving readiness.

articles.title: 新加坡三部门联合发布个人AI智能体安全须知
articles.summary: Three Singaporean government agencies jointly released safety guidelines for personal AI agents. This marks a significant regulatory move in Southeast Asia to address risks from autonomous AI systems at the consumer level.

articles.title: Claude累计已挖出3.8万个漏洞，然而管挖不管埋？
articles.summary: Anthropic's Claude has identified approximately 38,000 software vulnerabilities through automated security scanning, but the system reportedly does not assist in patching the flaws it discovers. This raises concerns about the responsible deployment of AI-powered cybersecurity tools and the gap between vulnerability detection and remediation.

articles.title: Data Centers Will Continue to Be Built, Despite Midterm Elections
articles.summary: Despite political headwinds from midterm elections slowing some approvals, major tech companies are pressing ahead with large-scale AI data center construction. The continued investment underscores the long-term commitment by hyperscalers to AI infrastructure regardless of short-term political fluctuations.

articles.title: Runway 开源 27B 世界动作模型 Praxis-1：登顶机器人权威榜单，全面支持 Apache 2.0 商业开源
articles.summary: Runway open-sourced Praxis-1, a 27B-parameter world action model for robotics under Apache 2.0, releasing full weights, inference, and fine-tuning code while topping a leading robotics benchmark. The open-source release of a top-performing embodied AI model intensifies competition in the robotics foundation model space and lowers barriers for commercial development.

articles.title: Holiday Extras is rethinking what it can build with Codex
articles.summary: Travel company Holiday Extras is using OpenAI's Codex to convert domain expertise from customer-facing staff into improved applications, boosting booking conversion rates. The case study illustrates how enterprise AI coding tools are enabling non-traditional software teams to build competitive digital products.

articles.title: Google and Samsung’s Android XR Smart Glasses Are Finally Here
articles.summary: Google and Samsung have launched Android XR smart glasses in partnership with eyewear brands Warby Parker and Gentle Monster, priced between $395 and $449. The release marks a significant step in bringing AI-integrated wearables to mainstream consumers and intensifies competition with Meta's Ray-Ban smart glasses.

articles.title: The Definitive Fine-Tuning Guide for 3D Generation Models
articles.summary: A comprehensive guide to fine-tuning 3D generative AI models has been published, covering techniques and best practices for adapting these models to specific use cases. This contributes to the growing body of practical knowledge enabling wider deployment of 3D generation technology.

articles.title: Apple’s HomeView Tries Face Authentication Without FaceID
articles.summary: Apple's upcoming smart home device, HomeView, will use a new 'person recognition' technology for face-based authentication rather than the established FaceID system. The approach represents a novel application of computer vision for home security but introduces untested risks in a real-world deployment.

articles.title: Here’s How Google Says It’s Making Its Smart Glasses More Private
articles.summary: Google is emphasizing privacy as a key differentiator for its Android XR smart glasses compared to Meta's competing product. The positioning reflects how data handling has become a central competitive battleground in the emerging AI wearables market.

articles.title: Alex Karp Said He’s a ‘Progressive.’ OK! Here’s Some Other Stuff He’s Said Recently
articles.summary: Palantir CEO Alex Karp described himself as 'progressive' in a recent interview, but his public statements during the company's earnings call reveal a more hawkish and militaristic worldview. The contrast highlights tensions in how AI defense contractors position themselves politically while expanding government and military contracts.

articles.title: 张一鸣最新定调：字节有能力与Anthropic和OpenAI竞争，但追平前沿最早要到2029年
articles.summary: ByteDance co-founder Zhang Yiming stated the company believes it can compete with Anthropic and OpenAI, but acknowledged that reaching the frontier of AI technology will take until 2029 or 2030 at the earliest. This candid timeline signals the scale of the gap between Chinese and leading US AI labs, with significant implications for the global AI race.

articles.title: Nvidia is reportedly preparing to fire Jensen Huang
articles.summary: Nvidia's board is reportedly preparing to dismiss CEO Jensen Huang following reports of a second extramarital affair with a company executive, compounding an earlier scandal involving an affair with a woman alleged to be a Chinese spy. The potential ouster of Huang, who has led Nvidia for 33 years and been central to its AI chip dominance, could have significant implications for the company and the broader AI hardware industry.

articles.title: Nvidia Working With Outside Firm to Identify CEO Options
articles.summary: Nvidia's board is working with an outside firm to identify potential CEO replacements for Jensen Huang, following reports of multiple affairs including one with a suspected Chinese spy. The formal succession search marks a significant escalation in the leadership crisis at the world's most valuable AI chip company.

articles.title: 字节跳动计划数周内推出新款AI助手，布局智能体赛道
articles.summary: ByteDance plans to launch a new AI assistant similar to Meta's within weeks, further expanding its agentic AI offerings alongside its existing video generation strengths. The move reflects ByteDance's accelerating push to close the gap with leading US AI labs, with founder Zhang Yiming directly rallying AI teams.

articles.title: OpenAI, Anthropic Valuations Fuel VC Fears of Startup Correction
articles.summary: OpenAI sought $30 billion in new capital at a $1.4 trillion valuation, raising concerns among VCs that sky-high AI startup valuations may be unsustainable and could trigger a broader correction. The divergence between OpenAI's and Anthropic's valuations is fueling anxiety about frothy AI funding conditions.

articles.title: Nvidia board meets on Jensen Huang's future as succession gap comes into focus
articles.summary: Nvidia's board has convened to discuss Jensen Huang's future as CEO amid the affairs scandal, with attention turning to the lack of a clear succession plan. The absence of an identified successor amplifies uncertainty for a company whose leadership has been deeply tied to its AI chip dominance.

articles.title: 平头哥分拆，难在阿里云
articles.summary: Alibaba's chip subsidiary Pingtouge (T-Head) is reportedly being spun off, with the central challenge being its deep dependency on Alibaba Cloud's resources and ecosystem. The spin-off raises questions about whether the chip unit can remain competitive in AI hardware independent of its parent cloud infrastructure.

articles.title: Alleged Chinese Spy at Center of Nvidia Firestorm Is in Beijing
articles.summary: The Chinese woman alleged to be a spy at the center of the Jensen Huang scandal has returned to Beijing, according to people familiar with the matter. Her departure to China further complicates the US national security investigation tied to Nvidia's leadership crisis.

articles.title: CoreWeave Plans to Raise at Least $4 Billion in High-Grade Loan
articles.summary: CoreWeave plans to raise at least $4 billion through an investment-grade loan after boosting its annual sales forecast. This signals continued investor confidence in AI infrastructure financing despite concerns about CoreWeave's heavy debt load.

articles.title: Huang Said to Have Had Affair With Nvidia Executive: NYT
articles.summary: The New York Times reported that Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang had an extramarital affair with Kimberly Powell, Nvidia's VP of Healthcare and a direct report. The revelation adds corporate governance pressure on the world's most valuable chip company at a critical moment for AI hardware supply.

articles.title: Meta’s Infrastructure Chief Is Leaving Amid Massive AI Buildout - The Information
articles.summary: Meta's infrastructure chief is departing the company amid its massive AI infrastructure expansion. The loss of a senior infrastructure leader during a critical AI buildout period could create execution risk for Meta's ambitions to compete at the frontier of AI.

articles.title: There Are Likely More Spies at AI Companies, Says Security Executive Lisa Thiergart - The Information
articles.summary: Security executive Lisa Thiergart warned that espionage at AI companies is likely more widespread than publicly known, citing the high strategic value of AI research. The statement underscores growing counterintelligence risks facing AI labs as geopolitical competition over AI intensifies.

articles.summary: Utah-based energy storage startup Torus raised $500 million to develop a modular, shipping container-sized product that integrates battery storage with AI computing infrastructure. The funding highlights the growing convergence of energy and AI hardware as data center power demands surge.

articles.title: Airbnb Is Building Its Own AI Travel Agent, Co-Founder Says
articles.summary: Airbnb co-founder Nathan Blecharczyk revealed the company is building its own specialized AI travel agent capable of booking both on and off the Airbnb platform. This move positions Airbnb to compete in the emerging AI-powered travel booking space while extending its reach beyond its own marketplace.

articles.title: How much is Anthropic really worth? Use our calculator
articles.summary: The Financial Times has published an interactive valuation calculator for Anthropic as the company prepares its Wall Street IPO debut, illustrating the wide range of plausible valuations from $500 billion to $4 trillion. The tool underscores deep uncertainty about how to price frontier AI companies given their rapid growth but significant losses.

articles.title: Booz Allen Switches to Nvidia’s Nemotron - The Information
articles.summary: Booz Allen Hamilton has switched to Nvidia's Nemotron model for its AI operations, signaling a major enterprise adoption milestone for the model. The move by a leading defense and government contractor underscores Nvidia's growing footprint beyond hardware into AI foundation models.

articles.title: Rapidus reportedly falls behind schedule on 2nm chip production target, raising questions over Japan's chip ambitions
articles.summary: Japan's Rapidus has reportedly fallen behind schedule on its 2nm chip production target, casting doubt on the country's ambitions to become a leading semiconductor manufacturer. The delay raises broader questions about whether national industrial policy efforts can realistically challenge established chipmaking leaders like TSMC.

articles.title: Elon Musk wants to build a s $24 billion gas-powered AI supercomputer in Texas company town
articles.summary: Elon Musk's SpaceX company town of Starbase, Texas, is set to vote on a proposed $24 billion gas-powered AI supercomputer data center project within its limits. Despite Musk's control over Starbase, local regulatory dynamics may complicate approval, highlighting the infrastructure and governance challenges of building large-scale AI compute facilities.

articles.title: AMD 亮出本地编程平台 Instinct Coder 355：一台机器塞进 98% 前沿模型
articles.summary: AMD and Spectro Cloud launched the Instinct Coder 355, an enterprise on-premises AI coding platform powered by eight MI355X GPUs capable of running frontier-level models at 98% performance parity with cloud alternatives. The platform targets enterprises seeking to keep AI workloads local, intensifying AMD's competition with Nvidia in the AI hardware and inference market.

articles.title: 上海国资，加码AI设计芯片 - 电子工程专辑EE Times China
articles.source_name: 电子工程专辑 (EE Times China)
articles.summary: Shanghai state-owned capital is increasing investment in AI chip design companies, reflecting China's strategic push to develop domestic semiconductor capabilities amid ongoing export restrictions. This move underscores the role of government-backed funding in accelerating China's AI hardware independence.

articles.title: 美司法部成立“超级智能特别工作组”，打击智能技术滥用活动
articles.summary: The U.S. Department of Justice has established a dedicated 'Superintelligence Task Force' aimed at combating criminal misuse of advanced AI technologies. This signals a significant escalation in federal law enforcement's focus on AI-related threats and regulatory oversight.

articles.title: BotPsy: On-Device Personal Assistant with a Sub-Billion-Parameter Agentic Language Model
articles.summary: BotPsy is a proposed on-device personal assistant powered by a sub-billion-parameter agentic language model. This research is relevant to the trend of deploying capable AI agents on edge devices without cloud dependency, addressing privacy and latency concerns.

articles.title: AMD unveils three-gen EPYC roadmap as TSMC 2nm process advances
articles.summary: AMD unveiled a three-generation roadmap for its EPYC server processors, timed alongside advances in TSMC's 2nm manufacturing process. The announcement signals AMD's intent to maintain competitive pressure on Intel and Nvidia in the data center chip market.

articles.title: 双11直播间爆改AI秀场，罗永浩上手TRAE，秒变AI Coding的大众嘴替
articles.summary: During China's Double 11 shopping festival, entrepreneur Luo Yonghao demonstrated Bytedance's TRAE AI coding tool in a live-stream, positioning it as an accessible AI coding platform for mainstream users. The event signals growing efforts by Chinese tech companies to popularize AI coding tools beyond developer communities.

articles.title: Cogent and OpenAI build cyber defense factories for enterprises
articles.summary: Cogent has partnered with OpenAI to build AI-powered cyber defense tools that automatically remediate enterprise vulnerabilities using agentic models with enterprise context. This signals an emerging category of AI-native cybersecurity solutions leveraging large language models to automate threat response.

articles.title: Nvidia’s crisis has corporate governance experts reaching for the popcorn
articles.summary: Corporate governance experts are scrutinizing an unprecedented situation unfolding at Nvidia, with observers describing it as unlike anything previously seen. The controversy raises questions about oversight and accountability at one of AI's most critical hardware suppliers.

articles.title: Singapore Airlines elevates travel & work with OpenAI technology
articles.summary: Singapore Airlines has integrated OpenAI models and APIs into its operations, doubling customer satisfaction scores for its Kris chatbot while also enhancing employee productivity and travel discovery tools. This deployment demonstrates growing enterprise adoption of frontier AI models for customer-facing and internal workflows in the aviation sector.

articles.title: The Download: preserving minds and weighing open AI risks
articles.summary: MIT Technology Review's daily newsletter covers two topics: speculative ideas for digital mind preservation and an assessment of risks associated with open-source AI models. These discussions reflect broader debates in AI safety, identity, and the tradeoffs of open versus closed AI development.

articles.title: ChatGPT Plus for veterans and servicemembers
articles.summary: OpenAI reports that more than 20,000 U.S. veterans and transitioning service members have claimed free one-year ChatGPT Plus subscriptions, primarily using the tool to prepare for civilian careers. The program demonstrates a growing use of AI assistants for workforce transition and vocational upskilling in a high-impact social context.

articles.title: OpenAI Third-Quarter Revenue Soars Nearly 50% to $10 Billion
articles.summary: OpenAI's quarterly revenue reached $10 billion for the first time in Q3, driven by strong demand for its latest AI software products, representing nearly 50% growth. The milestone cements OpenAI's position as the most commercially successful frontier AI lab and intensifies pressure on competitors.

articles.title: Anthropic targets $1.4 trillion IPO
articles.summary: Anthropic has set its IPO price range at $70–$78 per share, targeting a valuation of up to $1.4 trillion, which would make it one of the largest IPOs ever. The valuation reflects enormous investor confidence in frontier AI but also comes in below some earlier expectations, signaling measured market sentiment.

articles.title: DeepMind reveals Gemini Robotics 2.5 and open safety benchmark "ASIMOV-jailbreak"
articles.summary: Google DeepMind revealed Gemini Robotics 2.5, achieving up to twice the success rate on certain tasks compared to its predecessor, alongside an open safety benchmark called 'ASIMOV-jailbreak' for evaluating robotic AI safety. The dual release advances both robotic AI capability and the nascent field of robot safety evaluation.

articles.title: Anthropic’s Giant IPO Will Tie It Closer to Nvidia
articles.summary: Nvidia plans to invest $10 billion in Anthropic as part of Anthropic's upcoming IPO, the largest single financial commitment from a major tech firm in the deal. The investment would tightly link the dominant AI chip maker with a leading foundation model company, reshaping competitive dynamics in the AI ecosystem.

articles.title: Trump says FBI probing Nvidia CEO Huang as China controversy deepens - Reuters
articles.summary: President Trump stated the FBI is investigating Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang in connection with his relationship with a woman identified as a Chinese intelligence asset. The federal probe elevates the scandal from a corporate governance issue to a national security matter with potential legal consequences.

articles.title: MiniMax开源H3-Image:10秒生成16MP图像，价格仅同档工具50%–70%
articles.summary: MiniMax released its open-weight H3-Image model on November 10, capable of generating 16MP 4K images in under 10 seconds—five times faster than mainstream alternatives—at 50–70% of competitor pricing. The model's combination of speed, quality, and open access significantly lowers the barrier for high-resolution image generation and challenges proprietary incumbents.

articles.title: Gemini Robotics 2.5 accelerates real-world general dexterity
articles.summary: Google has released Gemini Robotics 2.5, its most capable vision-language-action model, designed to improve robot dexterity, reliability, and safety in real-world tasks. The advancement accelerates the integration of frontier AI reasoning into physical robotics systems, a key battleground for general-purpose AI.

articles.title: Google releases Gemini 4 Carbon with agent ‘swarm’ feature
articles.summary: Google has released Gemini 4 Carbon to the general public, touting it as its strongest model yet with an agent 'swarm' feature and cybersecurity capabilities competitive with Anthropic and OpenAI. The release marks a significant escalation in the frontier model race and introduces multi-agent coordination as a key differentiator.

articles.title: OpenAI, Anthropic face new oversight as New York’s AI safety law takes effect
articles.summary: New York's AI safety law has taken effect, requiring major AI developers like OpenAI and Anthropic to register, disclose safety practices, and report critical incidents or face financial penalties. The regulation represents one of the most concrete state-level AI oversight frameworks in the US, setting a precedent that could influence national policy.

articles.title: Amazon and Google Will See Big Paydays from Anthropic IPO
articles.summary: Amazon and Google, as Anthropic's largest investors, stand to gain hundreds of billions of dollars in value if Anthropic's anticipated IPO proceeds. The payoff would validate the hyperscalers' strategy of making large early bets on frontier AI labs to secure both financial returns and strategic cloud partnerships.

articles.title: Alibaba AI chip unit T-Head files for Hong Kong IPO - Reuters
articles.summary: Alibaba's AI chip unit T-Head has filed for an IPO on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange, seeking to raise capital to compete in the global AI semiconductor market. The listing signals China's push to develop independent AI chip capabilities amid ongoing U.S. export restrictions.

articles.title: OpenAI Revenue Jumps to $10 Billion in Third Quarter Amid Growing Losses - The Information
articles.summary: OpenAI's revenue surged to $10 billion in the third quarter, though losses also continued to grow at a significant pace. The figures underscore OpenAI's rapid commercial traction while highlighting the enormous costs of competing at the frontier of AI development.

articles.title: Anthropic Discloses Over $10 Billion in New Deals with Microsoft, Google; Says Lambda Deal May Be Cancelled - The Information
articles.summary: Anthropic has disclosed over $10 billion in new cloud computing deals with Microsoft and Google, while revealing that a previously announced deal with Lambda may be cancelled. These partnerships cement Anthropic's deep ties with the two dominant cloud providers and reduce its dependence on independent GPU cloud operators.

articles.title: Anthropic Sets Lower than Expected Valuation, Seeks to Raise $90 Billion in IPO - The Information
articles.summary: Anthropic is seeking to raise funds at a valuation of approximately $90 billion in its IPO, with early reports suggesting this is lower than some investor expectations. The offering will be a key test of public market appetite for high-growth, pre-profitability AI companies.

articles.title: TSMC plans investments in Anthropic, OpenAI; sets up investment firm to expand semiconductor strategy
articles.summary: TSMC is planning investments in both Anthropic and OpenAI and is establishing a dedicated investment firm to expand its strategic role in the AI ecosystem beyond chip manufacturing. This move positions the world's leading chipmaker as an active stakeholder in frontier AI, deepening the hardware-software integration across the AI supply chain.

articles.title: Alice Huang reportedly instrumental in securing over $7.5 billion of Nvidia AI GPU imports during three-year relationship with Jensen Huang
articles.summary: Alice Huang, the executive alleged to be a Chinese spy in a relationship with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, reportedly played a key role in facilitating over $7.5 billion worth of Nvidia GPU imports for Chinese companies over three years. The report raises serious national security concerns about whether U.S. export controls on advanced AI chips were effectively circumvented through personal relationships at the executive level.

articles.title: Anthropic has its own AI-powered office suite now
articles.summary: Anthropic has launched an AI-powered office productivity suite, expanding beyond its enterprise and coding tools to compete more directly with OpenAI and other frontier labs in workplace applications. The move signals Anthropic's ambition to broaden its commercial footprint as it approaches its IPO.

articles.title: All 7 Anthropic founders will each cash out about $250M in IPO
articles.summary: All seven Anthropic co-founders plan to sell identical share allocations in the company's IPO, each netting approximately $250 million while collectively retaining control of the company. The structured insider sale reflects both the founders' confidence in the company's long-term trajectory and their desire to maintain governance control post-IPO.

articles.title: PSI is trying to make a business out of AI-driven scientific discovery
articles.summary: Startup PSI used an unreleased Anthropic model to answer a longstanding fundamental question in quantum computing, aiming to commercialize AI-driven scientific discovery. This signals a growing market for AI applied to hard scientific problems, potentially accelerating research timelines across disciplines.

articles.title: Anthropic launches Claude Meetings to turn workplace discussions into plans and tasks
articles.summary: Anthropic launched Claude Meetings, an AI assistant that joins live workplace calls to draft plans, create timelines, answer questions, and retrieve information from connected work apps in real time. The product deepens Claude's integration into enterprise workflows, intensifying competition with Microsoft Copilot and Google's workplace AI tools.

articles.title: Google broadens its AI hardware portfolio with two new specialized chips
articles.summary: Google unveiled two new specialized tensor processing units (TPUs) designed for confidential model training and higher memory capacity, broadening its AI hardware portfolio. This expands Google's ability to serve diverse enterprise AI workloads and reduces reliance on third-party chip suppliers.

articles.title: AI training startup Mercor valued at $20 billion in latest funding round - Reuters
articles.summary: AI training data startup Mercor has been valued at $20 billion in its latest funding round, reflecting surging investor demand for infrastructure supporting AI model training. The valuation underscores how ancillary AI services, particularly data and human feedback pipelines, are attracting massive capital.

articles.title: CoreWeave Quiets Doubts About AI Business With Upbeat Outlook
articles.summary: AI cloud computing provider CoreWeave delivered a strong quarterly report with upbeat forward guidance, easing investor fears about its heavily debt-financed business model and slowing AI infrastructure demand. The results suggest that enterprise demand for AI compute remains robust despite broader data center industry headwinds.

articles.title: Nvidia Board Members Tap Wachtell’s Kim for Huang Probe
articles.summary: Nvidia's independent board members have hired a former top federal prosecutor from law firm Wachtell to lead an internal investigation into CEO Jensen Huang's ties to a suspected Chinese intelligence operative. The formal legal probe signals that the board is treating the matter as a serious corporate governance and national security issue.

articles.title: Anthropic Investors Shop IPO Shares Early, and at a Big Premium
articles.summary: Some early Anthropic investors are offering portions of their IPO share allocations to new investors at a significant premium ahead of what could be a record-breaking public listing. This signals exceptionally high demand for Anthropic equity and reflects broader investor enthusiasm for frontier AI companies.

articles.title: CoreWeave plans multibillion-dollar chip-backed debt deal
articles.summary: CoreWeave is pursuing a multibillion-dollar asset-backed debt deal, using its chip infrastructure as collateral and leveraging customer pre-payments to secure financing. This reflects the growing complexity of funding AI infrastructure buildouts as traditional capital markets struggle to keep pace with demand.

articles.title: Nvidia hires former US prosecutor at Wachtell to lead Jensen Huang probe
articles.summary: Nvidia has retained prominent law firm Wachtell Lipton, hiring a former federal prosecutor, to lead an independent investigation into CEO Jensen Huang's alleged romantic relationship with an individual accused of being a Chinese spy. The probe reflects heightened scrutiny of potential national security vulnerabilities at the top of one of the world's most critical AI chip companies.

articles.title: Goldman Sachs expects Anthropic revenue to exceed $600bn by 2030
articles.summary: Goldman Sachs projects Anthropic's revenue will exceed $600 billion by 2030, representing a roughly 130-fold increase from current levels, with the company becoming cash-flow positive by decade's end. The forecast reflects Wall Street's increasingly bullish stance on frontier AI monetization, adding pressure on competitors to scale rapidly.

articles.title: Trahan crafting AI safety bill with narrower state preemption
articles.summary: Congresswoman Trahan is drafting an AI safety bill that would preempt state AI regulations only in a narrower set of circumstances, a shift from broader federal preemption proposals. This approach reflects ongoing political tensions between federal AI oversight and states' rights to regulate AI, particularly in a potentially Democrat-controlled Congress.

articles.title: Google Grapples With AI’s Hit to Its Ads Juggernaut - The Information
articles.summary: Google is grappling with the impact of AI-powered search and competitors on its core advertising business, as AI-generated answers reduce user clicks on traditional search ads. This represents a structural threat to Google's primary revenue engine and signals a broader industry shift in how AI is reshaping digital advertising economics.

articles.title: Microsoft lobbies against potential ban on Chinese optical networking gear for AI data centers as FCC mulls restricting imports
articles.summary: Microsoft is lobbying against a potential FCC ban on Chinese-made optical networking components used in AI data centers, arguing the restrictions could disrupt critical infrastructure buildouts. The case illustrates the tension between national security-driven supply chain decoupling and the practical hardware dependencies of U.S. AI infrastructure.

articles.title: 2026，AI应用的钱都流向了哪里？
articles.summary: This article examines where AI application investment is flowing in 2026. It highlights shifting capital allocation trends that signal which sectors and use cases are winning commercial traction in the maturing AI market.

articles.summary: A news roundup covers Anthropic's IPO pricing targeting a ~$1 trillion valuation, Alibaba's plan to spin off its chip unit Pingtouge for a Hong Kong IPO, and TSMC approving a $409 billion capital budget for capacity expansion. articles.summary: A news digest reports that Alibaba plans to spin off its chip subsidiary Pingtouge for an independent Hong Kong listing, Anthropic has begun its IPO roadshow, and Trump claims the FBI is investigating Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang. These items reflect major corporate and regulatory developments at the intersection of AI, chips, and geopolitics.

articles.title: ChatGPT is getting verified AI ‘Business Agents’
articles.summary: ChatGPT is launching verified 'Business Agents'—brand-representing AI agents that assist users with tasks like comparison shopping—initially available to eligible US e-commerce businesses in beta. The feature transforms ChatGPT into a commerce intermediary, raising significant questions about market power and competition with traditional search and retail platforms.

articles.title: Adobe is going all in on agentic AI
articles.summary: Adobe announced at its Max conference that it is fully embracing agentic AI, enabling third-party AI agents to access and modify creative workflows within its tools. The strategy positions Adobe as an open platform in the agentic AI ecosystem, aiming to remain relevant as AI increasingly automates creative tasks.

articles.title: OpenAI acquires Odessia, travel startup created by Sonder founder
articles.summary: OpenAI has acquired Odessia, a travel startup founded by Sonder co-founder Francis Davidson, though its plans for the company remain undisclosed. The acquisition suggests OpenAI is exploring AI applications in the travel vertical, potentially signaling an expansion of its agentic or consumer product ambitions.

articles.title: Oura to acquire AI-native primary care startup Counsel Health for $625M
articles.summary: Wearable health company Oura is acquiring AI-native primary care startup Counsel Health for $625 million, weeks after postponing its own IPO due to market uncertainty. The deal signals growing investment in AI-powered healthcare and the consolidation of health data and clinical AI capabilities under consumer wellness platforms.

articles.title: Grok Build coding agent leaks oodles of confidential info, some belonging to SpaceXSI
articles.summary: A researcher discovered that approximately 35,000 Grok Build apps were publicly exposed, leaking confidential information including data tied to SpaceX. The breach highlights serious security and privacy risks in AI-powered development platforms, particularly those with insufficient access controls.

articles.title: Nvidia has a Jensen Huang problem—and no obvious successor
articles.summary: Nvidia faces investor and governance concerns over CEO Jensen Huang's central role and the lack of a clear successor, compounded by a board probe into his relationship with a suspected Chinese spy. The situation exposes significant leadership concentration risk at the company most critical to global AI infrastructure.

articles.title: Why Nvidia and Jensen Huang Matter So Much to Markets
articles.summary: Reports of Jensen Huang's relationship with an alleged Chinese spy erased roughly $1 trillion in Nvidia market value, illustrating how leadership and geopolitical risk can directly impact financial markets for AI infrastructure companies. The episode highlights Nvidia's outsized systemic importance to global AI development.

articles.title: Stifel CEO on Anthropic, Integrating AI and Fed Policy
articles.summary: Stifel announced a partnership with Anthropic to deploy Claude-based tools aimed at helping financial advisers organize work and communicate with clients more effectively, without replacing human judgment. The deal illustrates the growing adoption of frontier AI models in regulated financial services and Anthropic's enterprise expansion strategy.

articles.title: Jensen Huang’s 700,000% Return Magnifies Nvidia Succession Risks
articles.summary: An in-depth profile examines Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's unique management style and the existential risks the company faces if he were to depart, given his central role in its extraordinary growth. The piece highlights how deeply Nvidia's culture, strategy, and competitive edge are tied to a single individual, raising concerns about long-term institutional resilience.

articles.title: CoreWeave Earnings Top Estimates, Boosts Annual Forecast
articles.summary: CoreWeave reported earnings that beat analyst estimates and raised its annual revenue forecast, signaling strong demand for AI compute infrastructure. However, analysts note the company faces ongoing challenges in securing additional capital to fund its capital-intensive expansion.

articles.title: US commerce department delays Megaspeed’s inclusion on trade blacklist
articles.summary: The U.S. Commerce Department delayed adding Megaspeed, a company connected to an alleged Chinese spy who reportedly had a relationship with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, to its trade entity blacklist. The delay raises questions about the government's approach to enforcing export controls on companies with potential ties to Chinese intelligence.

articles.title: US regulator postpones Wall Street push to trade AI computing futures
articles.summary: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission has postponed Wall Street's push to create futures contracts tied to AI computing power, citing concerns over potential price manipulation. The delay slows efforts to financialize AI compute as a tradeable commodity asset class.

articles.title: Alice Huang’s tangled web of connections
articles.summary: An investigative report traces the career and connections of Alice Huang, the executive alleged to be a Chinese spy who had a relationship with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, revealing ties to individuals with histories of regulatory violations. The profile deepens concerns about the extent of potential foreign influence surrounding Nvidia's leadership.

articles.title: SoftBank Writes Off $3.7 Billion on Advance Payments for Data Center Projects - The Information
articles.summary: SoftBank has written off $3.7 billion in advance payments made for data center projects that failed to materialize as planned. The loss highlights the financial risks of large speculative bets on AI infrastructure amid uncertain project timelines and execution challenges.

articles.title: OpenAI Acquires AI Travel Agent Odessia - The Information
articles.summary: OpenAI has acquired Odessia, an AI-powered travel agent startup, expanding its push into agentic applications beyond its core language model products. The acquisition signals OpenAI's ambition to build end-to-end AI products in high-value consumer verticals such as travel.

articles.title: Work at the Frontier: AI’s effect on freelance work
articles.summary: Joint research from OpenAI and Upwork finds that demand for freelance work is shifting, with AI-related projects commanding larger budgets and more hours while requiring new skill combinations. The findings provide early empirical evidence of how AI is restructuring labor markets and freelance economies.

articles.title: The US is winning the AI race. Jensen Huang could have blown it
articles.summary: An analysis argues that the US leads the global AI race but that espionage targeting of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang—given his central role in AI chip supply—represents a significant vulnerability. The piece underscores how control over AI hardware infrastructure has made key individuals and companies prime geopolitical targets.

articles.title: eBay appears to have shut the door on third-party AI agents
articles.summary: eBay has apparently blocked third-party AI agents, including Meta's Muse, from browsing its platform, cutting off automated AI-driven curation of marketplace listings. The move highlights a growing tension between platform owners and AI agent developers over data access and control in the emerging agentic AI ecosystem.

articles.title: OpenAI rolls out new business profiles, making ChatGPT just a little bit more like Google
articles.summary: OpenAI is rolling out new business profiles for ChatGPT to help companies surface their products and services through the AI interface, positioning ChatGPT as a consumer discovery engine. This move puts OpenAI in more direct competition with Google Search and other digital advertising platforms.

articles.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s affair with alleged Chinese spy: a timeline
articles.summary: Reports detail a timeline of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's affair with Alice Huang, a woman identified by U.S. intelligence as a Chinese asset, raising national security concerns. The scandal has triggered market turbulence and a formal board probe, threatening Nvidia's standing at the center of global AI chip supply chains.

articles.title: Ring, known for its doorbell cameras, launches a home security drone and an enterprise security robot
articles.summary: Amazon-owned Ring announced a home security drone and an enterprise security robot, extending its camera-based security brand into autonomous robotics. The move positions Amazon in a growing market for AI-powered physical security and autonomous patrol systems.

articles.title: Photoshop, Lightroom, and Premiere are making it easier to remove things
articles.summary: Adobe is adding new generative AI and automated editing features to Photoshop, Lightroom, and Premiere, including automatic object and blemish removal, as part of its expanded Firefly AI platform. These updates accelerate the mainstreaming of generative AI in professional creative tools, lowering the skill barrier for complex editing tasks.

articles.title: Meta’s AI agent Muse lands on Apple Watch and Android Wear OS
articles.summary: Meta's AI assistant Muse is now available on Apple Watch and Android Wear OS, allowing users to interact via voice, text, or dictation directly from their smartwatch. The expansion onto wearables marks a push to embed AI assistants more deeply into everyday consumer devices.

articles.title: Quanta Computer vice chairman sees no slowdown in US AI infrastructure investment after midterms
articles.summary: Quanta Computer's vice chairman stated he sees no signs of a slowdown in U.S. AI infrastructure investment following the midterm elections, suggesting political transitions are not dampening enterprise hardware spending. This is a bullish signal for the AI server and data center supply chain heading into 2025.

articles.title: Pay for Hugging Face Hub with your Google Cloud Account
articles.summary: Hugging Face now allows users to pay for Hub services using their Google Cloud account, deepening the integration between the two platforms. This billing partnership lowers friction for enterprise cloud users adopting open-source AI tools and strengthens the Google Cloud–Hugging Face alliance.

articles.title: Decision Models in Hugging Face
articles.summary: Hugging Face has introduced Decision Models as a new model category on its Hub platform. This expands the Hub's scope beyond generative AI into reinforcement learning and decision-making systems, broadening its relevance for agentic and control applications.

articles.title: The indie game community is in disarray over AI and Big Walk
articles.summary: Some Independent Games Festival jurors announced they would not vote for games using generative AI in any capacity, prompted by indie hit Big Walk disclosing limited AI use during development. The controversy highlights deepening tensions between AI adoption and creative community ethics, with potential implications for how AI use is disclosed and governed in creative industries.

articles.title: What happens to mathematics when AI becomes an oracle?
articles.summary: Mathematician Steven Strogatz, in discussing his new book, explores how AI acting as an oracle in mathematics could change the nature of proof, understanding, and discovery in the field. The piece raises deeper questions about intellectual authority and the role of human insight when AI can solve problems humans cannot.

articles.title: Gilbert + Tobin rethinks the business of law with AI
articles.summary: Australian law firm Gilbert + Tobin is rethinking its business model by integrating AI into legal workflows, as discussed by its CEO Sam Nickless. The case illustrates how AI is beginning to reshape professional services industries beyond tech, with implications for labor and productivity.

The release advances the capabilities of open-source long-horizon agentic models for complex software development tasks.

articles.title: Introducing AlphaProof Code: a breakthrough in verifying complex software at depth
articles.summary: DeepMind's AlphaProof Code agents generated three million lines of Lean proofs to formally verify Signal's core encryption library, marking a breakthrough in AI-assisted software verification at scale. This demonstrates that AI can now tackle complex, real-world cryptographic verification tasks with practical implications for software security and reliability.

articles.title: Anthropic Targets Valuation of Up to $1.4 Trillion for Blockbuster I.P.O.
articles.summary: Anthropic is targeting a fully diluted valuation of up to $1.4 trillion in what would be the largest-ever IPO of a frontier AI lab, amid market uncertainty about AI's long-term profitability. The listing would mark a landmark moment for AI commercialization and investor confidence in the sector.

articles.title: Anthropic seeks $1.3T valuation for blockbuster IPO
articles.summary: Anthropic is pursuing an IPO at a potential valuation of $1.3 trillion, significantly below the $2 trillion figure rumored earlier this year. The move would mark a major milestone for AI-focused companies going public and signals both investor appetite and tempered expectations for frontier AI lab valuations.

articles.title: 字节跳动 Seedream 5.5 正式登陆豆包：图片设计能力迎全方位升级

The launch strengthens ByteDance's position in the consumer AI application market for creative tools.

articles.summary: The United States RASA (Restricting AI Semiconductor Access) Act is analyzed as potentially cutting off Chinese companies' access to overseas AI computing resources. articles.title: The Jensen Huang Affair
articles.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has admitted to an affair with Alice Huang, a businesswoman suspected by US intelligence of being a Chinese corporate spy, creating a major corporate governance and national security scandal. articles.title: Nvidia spy allegations likely to spur laws to tighten China's access to AI chips - Reuters
articles.summary: US lawmakers and officials are expected to respond to the Nvidia spy scandal by tightening legislation restricting China's access to advanced AI chips. The affair is likely to accelerate existing export control efforts and intensify the US-China technology decoupling.

articles.title: Nvidia Faces Fresh US Scrutiny on Megaspeed Probe
articles.summary: Nvidia's general counsel intervened in a US government investigation into AI chip smuggling by Megaspeed International, raising concerns about Nvidia's potential influence over federal probes into China chip export violations. articles.summary: A new METR report following an 11-week investigation found that Anthropic is successfully using AI models to accelerate AI development, doubling its pace of model improvement compared to a year ago. Researchers find this alarming because rapid AI-assisted AI development could compress safety timelines and reduce human oversight opportunities.

articles.title: 清华姚期智团队新作：代数世界模型，让AI像牛顿一样思考
articles.summary: Yao Qizhi's team at Tsinghua University has introduced an algebraic world model aimed at enabling AI to reason about the physical world in a structured, law-like manner analogous to Newtonian physics. This approach could advance AI's capacity for systematic scientific reasoning and generalization beyond pattern matching.

articles.title: The US let Nvidia sell chips to an empty office in China
articles.summary: An approved Chinese firm on Nvidia's list of entities cleared to handle H200 AI chips, New Matrix, was found to have an empty office, raising serious questions about vetting by both Nvidia and the U.S. Commerce Department. This highlights critical gaps in export control enforcement that could allow restricted AI hardware to reach unauthorized parties in China.

articles.title: US intelligence believes Jensen Huang had affair with Chinese spy in honeypot operation
articles.summary: U.S. intelligence sources allege that Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang was targeted by Chinese intelligence in a honeypot operation involving a Megaspeed executive named Alice Huang. The claim raises national security concerns about potential influence operations targeting leaders of critical AI and semiconductor companies.

articles.title: AI Safety Advocates Make Gains After $110 Million Midterm Fight
articles.summary: Pro-AI-regulation candidates won key congressional races in midterm elections, supported by a $110 million political funding effort backed partly by Anthropic. This marks a significant shift in AI policy momentum, potentially paving the way for stricter federal oversight of AI development.

articles.title: US-China trade truce gains breathing room as BIS extends 50% Affiliates Rule suspension into 2027
articles.summary: The U.S. Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) has extended the suspension of the 50% Affiliates Rule into 2027 as part of the ongoing U.S.-China trade truce. This extension gives companies more breathing room in managing cross-border AI and chip supply chains amid ongoing geopolitical tensions.

articles.title: Global AI memory crunch drives Taiwan to launch advanced memory initiative
articles.summary: Taiwan has launched an advanced memory initiative in response to a global AI-driven memory shortage constraining AI hardware development. This move positions Taiwan to play a larger role in alleviating the memory bottleneck that is limiting AI infrastructure scaling.

articles.title: TSMC denies exploring 3D DRAM at Nvidia's request
articles.summary: TSMC has denied reports that it is exploring 3D DRAM production at Nvidia's request, though the reports indicate Nvidia is actively seeking solutions to AI memory shortages. The denial highlights the urgency of memory constraints on AI hardware scaling and the industry's search for next-generation memory solutions.

articles.title: AI broke the cybersecurity world. What’s next?
articles.summary: Cybersecurity expert Alex Stamos discusses how AI has dramatically disrupted the cybersecurity landscape, creating new attack vectors and defensive challenges. The conversation highlights the urgent need for updated security frameworks as AI capabilities outpace existing protection strategies.

articles.title: 2026年，腾讯疯狂“补课”

articles.summary: Crusoe Energy has sold its troubled Wyoming AI data center project to Google, citing the significant challenges of building large-scale AI infrastructure. articles.title: 重估AI：“Not Even the End of the Beginning”
articles.summary: A Chinese commentary argues that AI development is still at a very early stage, echoing Churchill's phrase 'not even the end of the beginning.' The piece urges a recalibration of expectations around AI's current capabilities and long-term trajectory.

articles.title: UK will not slow down on AI despite backlash in US, says growth minister
articles.summary: UK growth minister Dan Tomlinson stated that Britain will not slow its AI investment pace despite backlash in the US, arguing current investment levels are insufficient to keep the UK at the AI frontier. The statement signals a diverging regulatory and investment posture between the UK and the US on AI development.

articles.title: OpenAI Expected to Brief Investors Next Week After Raising $11 Billion - The Information
articles.summary: OpenAI is expected to brief investors next week following its latest $11 billion fundraising round. The briefing signals continued strong investor appetite for the company and may shed light on its commercialization roadmap and financial trajectory.

articles.title: Apps for Caregivers Get a Dose of AI, but That Might Not Be Enough
articles.summary: Caregiver-focused apps are integrating AI features to help families manage care logistics, but deeper issues around caregiver mental health and burnout remain unaddressed. The development illustrates both the promise and limitations of AI in sensitive, human-centered applications.

articles.title: OpenAI Completes $11 Billion Portion of Funding at $1.25 Trillion Value
articles.summary: OpenAI has closed on $11 billion in new funding at a $1.25 trillion valuation, with the full round potentially reaching $20 billion. This makes OpenAI one of the most valuable companies in the world and dramatically expands its resources for model development and infrastructure.

articles.summary: China's Ministry of State Security recruited Megaspeed executive Alice Huang to spy on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and gather intelligence on advanced American AI chips, potentially to influence chip export policy. articles.title: AI boom turns chip packaging into the next battleground for semiconductors - Reuters
articles.summary: The AI-driven chip boom is turning advanced chip packaging technology into a major new competitive battleground in the semiconductor industry. articles.title: Neocloud Groq Aims to Double Value to $8 Billion Amid AI Selloff
articles.summary: AI inference neocloud Groq is seeking to double its valuation to approximately $8 billion in roughly three months, while criticizing competitors for excessive reliance on debt financing. articles.title: Anthropic to press ahead with IPO targeting $1.5tn valuation
articles.summary: Anthropic is pressing ahead with an IPO targeting a $1.5 trillion valuation, aiming to list before Thanksgiving despite a significant downturn in tech markets. articles.title: TSMC Weighs Making Advanced Memory Chips to Capture More AI Spending - The Information
articles.summary: TSMC is weighing entry into advanced memory chip manufacturing to capture a larger share of AI-driven semiconductor spending. This potential expansion would intensify competition in the high-bandwidth memory market critical to AI accelerator performance.

articles.title: Anthropic’s R&D Speed May Have Doubled Due to AI, Researchers Find - The Information
articles.summary: Researchers have found that Anthropic's use of AI tools may have doubled its internal R&D speed, according to The Information. articles.summary: Chinese robotics expert Xiong Youjun discusses how robots capable of running, jumping, and dancing can be translated into real-world practical value. articles.summary: Former OpenAI employee Abdulrahman Alfozan, a Saudi Arabian national arrested last month on espionage charges, has pleaded not guilty after a bug was discovered in the company's office. articles.title: All the latest updates on AI data centers
articles.summary: A roundup of ongoing developments around AI data centers covers the massive infrastructure buildout by tech companies and the resulting conflicts over energy consumption, utility costs, and community impact. This infrastructure race is a critical bottleneck shaping the pace and geography of AI development globally.

articles.title: Anthropic Launches Personal Finance Feature for Claude - The Information
articles.summary: Anthropic has launched a personal finance feature for its Claude AI assistant, expanding the chatbot's capabilities into consumer financial management. This move signals Anthropic's push into specialized consumer applications to diversify revenue beyond enterprise and API customers.
